_header.name: public-privacy baseline structural denylist
_header.description: Versioned, fail-closed baseline of STRUCTURAL regex patterns scanned against public/ assets when no operator denylist is present. Operator terms (DADAIA_PRIVACY_DENYLIST / .dadaia/states/privacy_denylist.json) are ADDITIVE and merge on top of this baseline. Patterns are conservative to avoid false positives on SHA hashes in lockfiles, doc/loopback IP ranges, and example hostnames. Edit only via an approved release task; bump 'version' on change.
excludes: RFC-2606 reserved TLDs in email domains (.invalid/.test/.example/.localhost), any depth of subdomain — v0.9.0

workspace.local (the exact literal only, in both the internal-hostname pattern and as an email domain) — the product's own synthetic git commit identity host (git_subprocess.py's user.email=dadaia@workspace.local fallback); any OTHER *.local host, or *.workspace.local subdomain, still matches — v0.9.0 code-review remediation

Path.home / pathlib.Path.home (the exact literal only, case-sensitive) in internal-hostname — the stdlib dotted-attribute-chain idiom Path.home(), not a hostname; any OTHER *.home host (e.g. a real internal TLD) still matches — v0.9.0 code-review remediation, self-scan regression
